entries.body: Larkspur Advisory LLC runs one Google Workspace tenant for larkspur.example on the Business Standard edition, with 11 users, in use since 2021.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Admin console, Billing (subscriptions) and Account settings pages

entries.body: 2-Step Verification is allowed but not enforced. All 11 users are enrolled: the founder with a security key, eight staff (the office manager among them) with an authenticator app or Google prompt, and two staff with SMS codes.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Admin console, Security > 2-Step Verification settings; Users list, 2SV enrollment column

entries.body: One super admin, the founder, whose account has a security key. The office manager holds a limited custom admin role (user management and help desk) on an account without a security key. No other admin roles are assigned.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Admin console, Account > Admin roles, each role's assigned admins

entries.body: Whether the founder's personal email account is still set as a recovery address on the super admin account is not known.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Not visible to the operator; only the account holder can read it

entries.body: The admin audit log and the other audit logs are searchable in the console for about six months. Nothing is exported or kept beyond that, and no log is sent to a SIEM: the firm has none.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Admin console, Reporting > Audit and investigation pages

entries.body: Nobody reviews the admin audit log; the founder had not opened it before this audit.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the founder

entries.body: The operator ran CISA's ScubaGoggles v1.1.0 against the tenant on 2026-11-18 with the founder's super admin session, covering every product baseline. The operator holds the results report; the B, C, D and E entries summarize it.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles v1.1.0 run by the operator; results report held by the operator

entries.body: Authentication results: 2-Step Verification not enforced and no new-user enrollment period set; users may trust their device; no SSO profile is configured; web sessions last 14 days.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Common Controls sections 1, 3 and 4

entries.body: Password and account results: strength enforced, minimum length 8, not enforced at next sign-in, reuse allowed, no expiry. Super admin self-recovery on; user self-recovery off; users may add recovery information. Admin accounts are Google accounts with no external identity provider. No account is enrolled in the Advanced Protection Program. Account conflict management is not configured.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Common Controls sections 5 to 9

entries.body: App and service results: API controls not configured (third-party apps unrestricted, users may consent to low-risk scopes, internal apps trusted, unconfigured third-party apps allowed); less secure apps blocked; any Marketplace app may be installed; Takeout on. System-defined alert rules on at their defaults, several without email notification. Data region: no preference. Services without an individual control on; early access apps off; Looker Studio sharing outside the organization on; Pinpoint on.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Common Controls sections 10 to 16

entries.body: Domain-wide delegation lists one API client with Gmail and Drive scopes; which app or vendor it belongs to is not known.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Admin console, Security > API controls > Domain-wide delegation; no owner on record

entries.body: Gmail results: mail delegation on. Attachment protections (encrypted, scripted, anomalous types) on, with flagged mail kept in the inbox with a warning; future recommended attachment settings on. Shortened-URL and linked-image scanning on; the warning prompt for untrusted links off; future link settings on. Spoofing protections on for similar domain names and employee names and for Groups, off for inbound mail spoofing the firm's own domain and for any unauthenticated mail; flagged mail kept in the inbox; future spoofing settings on. User email uploads, POP and IMAP, and Workspace Sync on. Automatic forwarding off; per-user outbound gateways off; external reply warnings on; no email allowlist; enhanced pre-delivery scanning on; security sandbox off; comprehensive mail storage off; no spam-bypass lists.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Gmail baseline

entries.body: larkspur.example publishes one SPF record ending in a soft fail (~all); Gmail signs outbound mail with DKIM and the key is published; DMARC is at p=none, with aggregate reports (rua) to a mailbox at larkspur.example and no failure reports, and no sp or np tag.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (TXT at the apex, at the DKIM selector and at _dmarc); Admin console, Gmail > Authenticate email

entries.body: Nobody reads the DMARC report mailbox.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the founder

entries.body: Drive results: sharing outside the organization allowed with no allowlist, and receiving files from outside allowed; warnings shown when sharing outside; sharing with people who have no Google account allowed; "anyone with the link" allowed; access checking allows public targets; content may be moved to other organizations' shared drives; new items private to owner; out-of-domain file warnings on. Shared drive managers may override creation settings; non-members may be added to files; the Drive file security update applied; Drive SDK on; Drive for desktop allowed on any device.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Drive and Docs baseline

entries.body: Fourteen items are shared "anyone with the link", six of them client folders.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Admin console, Reporting > Audit and investigation > Drive log events

entries.body: Whether Drive for desktop's ransomware monitoring is on is not known: ScubaGoggles reports it as a manual check and the console page was not opened.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Drive and Docs section 5; console not checked

entries.body: Chat: history on, and users may change it; external file sharing on; space history on; external chat open to all domains; content reporting on for all conversation types with every category selected. Meet: uninvited external users must ask to join; meetings created by users outside any organization may be joined; host management on; external-participant warning off; automatic recordings and transcripts off. Calendar: primary calendars share free/busy only outside; secondary calendars share all event details; external invitation warnings on; Calendar Interop off; appointment schedules with payments on. Groups: access from outside the organization off unless granted; owners may add external members and let non-members post; any user may create groups; conversations viewable by all group members; groups may be hidden from the directory. Sites: on for all users.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Chat, Meet, Calendar, Groups and Sites baselines

entries.body: The Meet settings for AI-generated meeting notes (who may override sharing, the default sharing level, screenshots in notes) are not known: ScubaGoggles reports them as manual checks and the console page was not opened.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: ScubaGoggles results, Meet section 6; console not checked

entries.body: The bookkeeper pays suppliers and changes payment details on email instructions from the founder, without a call-back step; clients receive payment instructions by email.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the founder and the bookkeeper
